info.title: CF Meet Messaging API
info.description: HTTP surface of services/messaging: GET /health, /ready, /openapi.json (public, no data); the customer API under /v1/messaging and /v1/conversations (CF Meet API credential verified by Platform Access — afresh for every mutation; a verified acting principal; 503 when Platform Access is unreachable — fail closed; client tokens are accepted only on the member operations whose security lists clientToken (elsewhere 401 CLIENT_TOKENS_NOT_ENABLED); the device-direct realtime routes /v1/realtime/tickets (client token) and /v1/realtime (WebSocket, single-use ticket) authenticate themselves). /internal/v1/** is service-authenticated and exposes no operation yet. Request bodies are limited to 512 KiB. 1.13.0: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}/thread (thread summary); pin expiry; conversation retentionSeconds / expiryGraceSeconds. Member roles, invitations (POST .../invitation/accept|decline, GET /v1/messaging/invitations). 1.14.0: existing DIRECT creation accepts counterpartCfMeetId, and membership addition accepts cfMeetId, as exclusive alternatives to principal UUIDs. Personal scope only; server-authenticated actor, purpose-bound resolution and authoritative policy checks; no new endpoints. 1.16.0: x-cfmeet-required-scope (the API Gateway scope pre-check) on the 92 credential operations whose handler requires exactly one registry scope (including the Section 13 session-device issue / revoke: messages.read / messages.send); GET /v1/conversations, GET /v1/conversations/{id} and GET/DELETE …/members keep a per-request choice (messages.read with an acting principal, else conversations.manage) and stay upstream-checked (Section 15, PLT-011). 1.17.0: GET /v1/messaging/push/configuration (push platforms of the deployment and the Web Push application-server key; messages.read). 1.20.0 (CF Meet Platform Build, ADR 0062 / 0063): the userToken security scheme (Authorization: Bearer cfut_..., a CF Meet user token verified by Platform Access); POST /v1/messaging/user-sessions exchanges it for a MANAGED-only partner session device and client token (EXTERNAL environments, msg grant; MESSAGING_PARTNER_SESSION_DEVICES_ENABLED); PUT / DELETE /v1/messaging/user-push-registrations/{installationId} (partner push registrations synchronised to the Notification Service; MESSAGING_PARTNER_PUSH_ENABLED). A partner session device's client token reaches only a closed MANAGED-only allowlist of the clientToken member operations (conversations and members read; messages list / get / send / edit / delete; reactions; read cursor; unread; events; attachments create / finalize / get / download grants; conversation search; reports): every other operation answers 401 CLIENT_TOKENS_NOT_ENABLED / PARTNER_ROUTE_NOT_ALLOWED and a PRIVATE_E2EE conversation answers 404. Realtime tickets and WebSocket upgrades of partner session devices also accept the environment's allowed websites (Platform Access) as Origin. 1.21.0 (CF Meet Apps, ADR 0064; MESSAGING_APPS_ENABLED): the oauthAccessToken security scheme (Authorization: Bearer cfoa_… OAuth access token or cfob_… bot token of a CF Meet App, verified by Platform Access) on the operations an app may use: conversations and members (read), messages (list, get, send, edit, delete), reactions, read cursor, unread, events, attachments (create, finalize, get, download grants), conversation search, search across the principal's MANAGED conversations, reports and invitation accept / decline. An OAuth credential acts only as the one principal it is restricted to (the granting user or the app's organization bot; CF-Acting-Principal may only repeat it, else 403 PRINCIPAL_NOT_AUTHORIZED / ACTING_PRINCIPAL_MISMATCH), sees MANAGED conversations only (PRIVATE_E2EE answers 404 and is absent from lists and search counts), and every other operation answers 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE / OAUTH_ROUTE_NOT_ALLOWED (with the flag off every operation answers 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE / OAUTH_NOT_ENABLED). Messages an app sent carry viaApplicationId. A CF Meet App's bot (BOT_OR_SERVICE, reference app:<appId>) is a member of MANAGED conversations only (403 PRINCIPAL_NOT_AUTHORIZED / APP_BOT_MANAGED_ONLY). 1.22.0: MLS self-join: submitMlsCommit accepts groupInfo (the GroupInfo of the new epoch) and external commits of the acting principal's own ACTIVE device; getMlsGroupState returns the current epoch's groupInfo; the device directory shows keyPackagesAvailable for the acting principal's own devices; claimKeyPackages can be limited to deviceIds. 1.23.0 (chat controls): PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/inbox-settings (F1: the member's own archive / pin, at most three pins; returned in the inbox summary); PRIVATE_E2EE sends accept mentionedPrincipalIds (B3, ids only); PATCH retentionSeconds may lengthen or turn off disappearing messages (null) within the policy, by a chat admin (B4). 1.24.0 (chat organization and polls): favourite on PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/inbox-settings and in the inbox summary (WhatsApp Favourites); the member's own chat lists GET / POST /v1/messaging/chat-lists, PATCH / DELETE /v1/messaging/chat-lists/{listId}, PUT / DELETE /v1/messaging/chat-lists/{listId}/conversations/{conversationId} (at most 20 lists of 500 conversations; never visible to anyone else; removing an item never touches the conversation); MANAGED polls (send with poll; PUT .../messages/{messageId}/poll/vote, POST .../messages/{messageId}/poll/close; events messaging.poll.voted / closed carry the current tally); a MANAGED group's description (create / PATCH description) and group photo (avatarRef attachment:<attachmentId>); a group admin may change title, avatarRef and description. 1.25.0 (ADR 0069): Status (24-hour statuses with server-enforced audience snapshots of mutual contacts, close friends and named lists, mutes, rings, viewers, reactions, replies, forwards and reshares) and Channels under /v1/messaging/status and /v1/messaging/channels, with resumable part uploads to protected object storage. Status content is stored server-side (not end-to-end encrypted). 1.26.0: PATCH /v1/messaging/status/{statusId} (the author's Allow sharing per status). 1.27.0 (ADR 0071): Events under /v1/messaging/events: personal and conversation events (organization and community scopes reserved), co-organizers, invitations, RSVP with counts, per-person reminders, server-side recurrence (RRULE subset in the event time zone), cancellation, ICS export as JSON, cover photos in the ADR 0069 media store and a link to a CF Meet meeting (no scheduling in Messaging). Event text is stored server-side (not end-to-end encrypted). 1.28.0 (ADR 0072): Channels complete under /v1/messaging/channels: unique handles, PUBLIC / PRIVATE channels, invite links, admins and ownership transfer, mute, discovery filters / sort / cursor, suggestions, handle lookup, every post kind with polls, scheduled posts, pins, edits, stars, views and forwards, reports, verification applications (decided only by HQ through the admin bridge), moderation history, audit log and analytics. 1.29.0 (ADR 0073): Communities under /v1/messaging/communities (groups under one structure with an Announcements group, linked or created groups with OPEN / RESTRICTED access, invitations, revocable invite links, join requests, bans, roles OWNER / ADMIN / MEMBER and group admins, chat-list preference); every community resource answers 404 to non-members; joining a group opens a new history window (nothing earlier is visible). 1.30.0 (ADR 0074): GET /v1/messaging/status/{statusId}/replies (the author's private replies of a live status); Status.replyCount, StatusViewer.reactedAt and the rings' mentionedMe flags. 1.31.0 (ADR 0071 / 0073): COMMUNITY events (communityId) for a community's ACTIVE members, created by its owner and admins; only ORGANIZATION stays reserved.

post.description: Scope messages.send, acting member. Commits the message with the next canonical sequence and its durable event in one transaction (no realtime publish before commit). PRIVATE_E2EE: the PUBLIC MLS framing must name this group, an application message and the group's current epoch (EPOCH_MISMATCH otherwise; MLS_REKEY_REQUIRED while removals are pending). Retries with the same clientMessageId and bytes replay (200). PRIVATE_E2EE application content must use MLS PrivateMessage wire format; public application frames are rejected with 422 CONTENT_REJECTED / APPLICATION_MUST_BE_PRIVATE. Public handshake commits remain supported. The server checks public framing and authenticated device authorization, not AEAD authenticity; receiving clients verify ciphertext before accepting content. S13: SEND_RESTRICTED / ANNOUNCEMENT_ONLY for a non-admin member of an announcement-only conversation. S2: PRIVATE_E2EE sends may carry frankingCommitment (verifiable reports). 1.24.0: MANAGED poll — poll (2-12 options; text is the question, 1-300 characters); refused for PRIVATE_E2EE (POLL_MANAGED_ONLY).

post.description: Scope messages.send, acting member. The MLS Delivery Service accepts exactly one commit per epoch (the first; others EPOCH_MISMATCH), stores it as an MLS_COMMIT message in the canonical sequence and the Welcome per welcomed device (ACTIVE devices of ACTIVE members only). A commit may carry the GroupInfo of the epoch it creates (stored and served by getMlsGroupState while current). An external commit (sender new_member_commit) is the acting principal's own ACTIVE device joining by itself, without any other member online: never with welcome or removedDeviceIds (422 EXTERNAL_COMMIT_CANNOT_WELCOME_OR_REMOVE), never while a removal of a device still in the tree is pending (409 MLS_REKEY_REQUIRED, reason REMOVALS_PENDING_BEFORE_JOIN).

customerCredential.description: A CF Meet API credential, verified by Platform Access (never by Messaging).

userToken.description: A CF Meet user token (`cfut_<sbx|test|live>_<JWS>`, at most 2048 bytes) minted by the partner's server for one partner user (ADR 0062). Messaging never verifies it itself: Platform Access does, live (a positive answer is reused at most 30 s). Accepted only by the operations that list it.

clientToken.name: Authorization
clientToken.description: CF-Client-Token <Messaging Client Access Token> (device-direct, §105). Accepted by POST /v1/realtime/tickets and, as an alternative to customerCredential, by the member operations that list it: the token's session (device ACTIVE, session ACTIVE and unexpired, principal ACTIVE) is the caller, acting only for its own principal and own device (CF-Acting-Principal may only repeat it). Every other operation answers 401 CLIENT_TOKENS_NOT_ENABLED.

realtimeTicket.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
realtimeTicket.description: `cfmeet.messaging.v1, cfmeet.ticket.<ticket>`: the single-use ticket travels as a subprotocol entry; the server answers `cfmeet.messaging.v1` only.

oauthAccessToken.description: A CF Meet App's OAuth access token (`cfoa_…`, acting for the granting CF Meet user) or bot token (`cfob_…`, acting as the app's organization bot), verified live by Platform Access (never by Messaging) — ADR 0064, MESSAGING_APPS_ENABLED. The credential acts only as the single principal it is restricted to, sees MANAGED conversations only (a PRIVATE_E2EE conversation is 404) and is accepted only by the operations that list it; elsewhere 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE / OAUTH_ROUTE_NOT_ALLOWED.

role.description: BOT_SERVICE only for BOT_OR_SERVICE principals (BOT_SERVICE_REQUIRES_BOT_PRINCIPAL); bots are never ADMIN / MODERATOR (BOT_CANNOT_ADMINISTER).

invite.description: §35: invite instead of adding. The principal becomes INVITED (no history, no events, no sends) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept); invitations expire after 7 days and count toward the member limit.

cfMeetId.description: Personal CF Meet ID resolved privately through Communications under the authenticated actor and scope. Exactly one recipient identifier is allowed. Rotation invalidates the old public ID; existing canonical conversations remain unchanged.

centralArchiveRequired.description: Only MANAGED is allowed (allowedProfiles must be [MANAGED]); an E2EE conversation can never be archived by the server.

exportsEnabled.description: Requires MANAGED; the server never exports E2EE plaintext.

smsBridgeEligible.description: Requires MANAGED among allowedProfiles; SMS is never end-to-end encrypted.

requestsRequireAcceptance.description: Appendix K (DIRECT only): a new direct conversation is a message request — the counterpart is INVITED (no delivery, events or key packages) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept), then sees the conversation from the start. While pending, PRIVATE_E2EE requests carry no messages (REQUEST_PENDING); after a decline nothing more is delivered (DELIVERY_REFUSED / REQUEST_DECLINED).

forwarding.description: S11: server-side forwarding of MANAGED messages (default true).

forwardShowsOriginalSender.description: S11: forwarded copies show their original sender (default false).

messaging.common.v1.ApplicationPolicy.description: An application environment's overrides of the platform defaults. MANAGED is available for a context only when listed here.

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

messaging.common.v1.Attachment.description: An attachment's authorized metadata and lifecycle. Bytes live in protected object storage under a server-generated key.

metadata.description: INSPECTION only: the measured facts (null for THUMBNAIL and until READY).

messaging.common.v1.AttachmentDerivative.description: A server-made derivative of a MANAGED attachment: a re-encoded PNG thumbnail of an image without the original's metadata (THUMBNAIL), or the measured container, duration and dimensions of an image, voice note or video (INSPECTION, no object). Never produced for PRIVATE_E2EE attachments, whose thumbnails the sending client encrypts itself.

residualAccessSeconds.description: A grant issued before a revocation stays usable at most this long; GET .../content re-checks authorization on every request.

messaging.common.v1.AttachmentDownloadGr.description: A short-lived signed read of one object forcing Content-Disposition: attachment and the stored content type. Issued only after authorization (current membership, history window, message ACTIVE, attachment READY).

mediaType.description: MANAGED: required, in the kind's allow-list. PRIVATE_E2EE: omit (or application/octet-stream).

messaging.common.v1.Backup.description: Metadata of an opaque backup object. keyId and clientBackupId come from the object's public header; the server cannot decrypt the object.

messaging.common.v1.BackupIntentRequest.description: An upload intent for one client-encrypted backup object (Appendix I.3). The client encrypts with the shared crypto core under a root key only the user holds; the server never receives a key or content.

messaging.common.v1.ChannelPost.description: A channel post (1.40.0: every kind, polls, link previews, pins, edits, stars; SCHEDULED until published).

publishAt.description: Publish later: 1 minute to 30 days ahead.

description.description: At most 500 characters; an empty string clears it.

handle.description: Unique per environment: 5-32 of a-z 0-9 _ starting with a letter (an @ and capitals are normalized); reserved words refused; an empty string clears it. Owner only.

category.description: NEWS, ENTERTAINMENT, SPORTS, BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY, EDUCATION, HEALTH, LIFESTYLE, MUSIC, GAMING, SCIENCE, POLITICS, RELIGION, TRAVEL, FOOD, FASHION, ART, COMMUNITY, GOVERNMENT, ORGANIZATION or OTHER; empty clears.

avatarMediaId.description: A COMPLETE channel image upload of the caller; null removes the picture.

position.description: The list's place in the member's own order (0 first).

conversationIds.description: Conversations of the list the member is still an ACTIVE member of, in the order they were added.

messaging.common.v1.ChatList.description: 1.36.0: one of the acting member's own chat lists (WhatsApp custom lists). Never visible to anyone else.

groupInfo.description: base64url MLSMessage (wire format mls_group_info) of the epoch this commit creates, signed by the committer, with the ratchet tree and external_pub extensions: PUBLIC material that lets a member's new device join by itself (RFC 9420 section 12.4.3.2). Its group id must be the conversation's and its epoch the commit's epoch + 1.

messaging.common.v1.CommitRequest.description: An MLS Commit created in the group's current epoch. removedDeviceIds is the committer's attestation of the leaves it removes; while removals are pending it must cover them all. An external commit (a PublicMessage whose sender is new_member_commit, RFC 9420 section 12.4.3.2) is a member's own ACTIVE device joining by itself: accepted only from the acting principal's own device, without welcome or removedDeviceIds, and not while a removal of a device still in the tree is pending; every member's client verifies the joining leaf against the device directory before merging it.

message.description: Optional note to the admins (a join request); at most 500 characters.

messaging.common.v1.ContextRef.description: An opaque reference in the application's own namespace. Never authority, never a membership grant.

readReceipts.description: Appendix K: false — no read receipts in this conversation; null — the environment policy decides.

title.description: Section 13: display title of a MANAGED conversation (always null for PRIVATE_E2EE, whose name belongs inside the MLS group).

avatarRef.description: Section 13: opaque avatar reference of a MANAGED conversation (for example an attachment id the client resolves); never a URL the server fetches. 1.36.0: attachment:<attachmentId> is a group photo attachment of the conversation.

announcementOnly.description: S13: only OWNER / ADMIN members may send (send, edit and forward); others read and react as policy allows.

description.description: 1.36.0: a MANAGED group's description (always null for DIRECT and PRIVATE_E2EE conversations, whose metadata belongs inside the MLS group).

messaging.common.v1.Conversation.description: The canonical Conversation aggregate. PRIVATE_E2EE: MLS 1.0 with the server-assigned 32-byte MLS group id; serverCanReadContent is false. MANAGED: no MLS binding; serverCanReadContent is true.

data.description: camelCase payload; message events carry the message's CURRENT representation (a deleted message replays as a tombstone).

messaging.common.v1.ConversationEvent.description: A durable conversation event (derived from committed state, replayable by its per-conversation eventSequence). Every durable event names its tenant, application and environment (§117).

messaging.common.v1.ConversationInbox.description: Section 13 (MSG-007): the inbox summary of a conversation for the acting member, present in GET /v1/conversations answers that have an acting principal. Left conversations are not listed (only ACTIVE memberships are); a tombstoned last message carries its lifecycle and no content.

lastActivityAt.description: The latest application message (or the creation time); the key of orderBy=lastActivity.

unreadCount.description: Active application messages from others after the member's read cursor, inside its history window, not hidden for it.

mentionCount.description: Unread messages that mention the member (the sender's declared mention ids: MANAGED and — B3, 1.34.0 — PRIVATE_E2EE, whose mention text stays inside the ciphertext).

archived.description: F1 (1.34.0): the member archived this chat for itself (PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/inbox-settings). It stays archived when new messages arrive. Never visible to other members.

pinned.description: F1 (1.34.0): the member pinned this chat for itself (at most three; clients list pinned chats first, most recently pinned first).

pinnedAt.description: F1 (1.34.0): when the member pinned this chat (the pin order); null when not pinned.

favourite.description: 1.36.0: the member marked this chat as a favourite for itself (PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/inbox-settings; WhatsApp Favourites). Independent of archive and pin; never visible to other members.
1.36.0: the chat is one of the member's Favourites.

messaging.common.v1.ConversationInboxSet.description: F1 (1.34.0): the acting member's own chat-list settings of one conversation. archived and pinned are not both true. 1.36.0: favourite.

messaging.common.v1.ConversationLastMess.description: Preview metadata of the last application message visible to the member (its history window and delete-for-me markers honoured).

previewText.description: MANAGED and ACTIVE only: the first 140 characters of the text. Always null for PRIVATE_E2EE (the server holds no plaintext and never returns ciphertext here) and for tombstones.

presentation.description: 1.36.0, MANAGED and ACTIVE only: the message's presentation (a poll previews its question).

attachmentKind.description: 1.36.0, MANAGED and ACTIVE only: the kind of the message's first attachment (e.g. IMAGE, VIDEO, VOICE_NOTE, DOCUMENT), for the chat list's icon.

oneOf.description: Opaque; valid only with the same orderBy.

name.description: Trimmed; unique (case-insensitively) among the member's lists (409 CONFLICT / CHAT_LIST_NAME_TAKEN).

conversationIds.description: Conversations to start with (each one the member is an ACTIVE member of, else 404).

managedDisclosureAcknowledged.description: Regulated contexts: creating a MANAGED conversation requires acknowledging that the server can read its content (refused otherwise with MANAGED_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED).

expiryGraceSeconds.description: §38: requires an expiring conversation. Past expiresAt the conversation refuses new messages (CONVERSATION_NOT_ACTIVE / EXPIRED) but stays readable and extendable for this many seconds before it becomes EXPIRED.

retentionSeconds.description: §90 / disappearing messages: a conversation-specific retention, never looser than the context's (or environment's) retention policy (RETENTION_LOOSER_THAN_POLICY). The retention worker expires older messages (tombstone, then purge unless a legal hold protects them); clients delete locally on the same timer. Audited.

predecessorConversationId.description: Appendix G: create a deliberate SUCCESSOR of this conversation (the only way to move to another security profile). The caller must be an ACTIVE OWNER / ADMIN of it; same context class (DIRECT: the same two principals); never a context-bound conversation (SUCCESSOR_CONTEXT_BOUND); one successor each (SUCCESSOR_EXISTS). No content and no members are copied.

profileChangeDisclosureAcknowledged.description: Required (true) when the successor's security profile differs from its predecessor's; refused otherwise with SECURITY_PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED / PROFILE_CHANGE_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED. Clients show the change (e.g. end-to-end encrypted to server-readable) before acknowledging.

readReceipts.description: Appendix K: false turns read receipts off for this conversation (never on where the environment policy has them off).

counterpartCfMeetId.description: Personal CF Meet ID resolved privately through Communications under the authenticated actor and scope. Exactly one recipient identifier is allowed. Rotation invalidates the old public ID; existing canonical conversations remain unchanged.

title.description: Section 13: display title (MANAGED only; PRIVATE_E2EE refuses it with CONTENT_REJECTED / DISPLAY_METADATA_MANAGED_ONLY).

description.description: 1.36.0: a group description (MANAGED, non-DIRECT only; trimmed; line breaks allowed, no other control characters).

messaging.common.v1.CreateConversationRe.description: A tenant / application / environment is never part of a request: it comes from the authenticated credential.

messaging.common.v1.CreateSmsBridgeReque.description: Bridge a MANAGED conversation to one external party by SMS. The number is passed to the SMS Gateway once and never stored by Messaging. A PRIVATE_E2EE conversation is never bridged (E2EE_CONVERSATION_NOT_BRIDGEABLE).

messaging.common.v1.DeletionRequest.description: Legal holds win: held items are preserved and counted (PARTIALLY_HELD).

signaturePublicKey.description: base64url Ed25519 MLS signature PUBLIC key (32 bytes).

keyPackagesAvailable.description: Published, unexpired, unclaimed KeyPackages of this device. Only in the acting principal's view of its OWN devices, so each device keeps a stock that others can add it from while it is offline.

messaging.common.v1.Device.description: A Messaging device: PUBLIC key material only (never a private key).

text.description: MANAGED plain text (UTF-8, 1-16384 characters, no control characters). No markup subset is defined: the server never interprets HTML, Markdown or scripts, stores the text exactly as given and returns it as a JSON string; clients render it as text (escaping it), never as markup.

expectedEditCount.description: Optimistic version check: the editCount the editor last saw. If another edit committed first the request is refused with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT (reason EDITED_CONCURRENTLY). Omitted: last writer wins.

smsBridgeEligible.description: A MANAGED conversation of this context may be bridged to SMS (default: whenever MANAGED is allowed; never for an E2EE-only context).

requestsRequireAcceptance.description: Appendix K (DIRECT only): a new direct conversation is a message request — the counterpart is INVITED (no delivery, events or key packages) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept), then sees the conversation from the start. While pending, PRIVATE_E2EE requests carry no messages (REQUEST_PENDING); after a decline nothing more is delivered (DELIVERY_REFUSED / REQUEST_DECLINED).

messages.description: Message features (platform policy version 4). Replies are always supported; a tenant may turn threads off (replies are kept without a thread root), reactions or pins.

forwarding.description: S11: server-side forwarding of MANAGED messages (default true).

forwardShowsOriginalSender.description: S11: forwarded copies show their original sender (default false).

deliveryReceipts.description: Other members learn when a message was DELIVERED to a recipient (messaging.delivery-cursor.updated / delivery-cursor.updated events).

revisionHistoryVisible.description: Members may read the kept revisions of edited MANAGED messages. Revisions are always kept (exports and legal holds include them).

messaging.common.v1.EffectivePolicy.description: Platform defaults merged with the application's overrides (deterministic; stored as an immutable content-addressed snapshot). Platform policy version 3 (Parts E-G): attachments (off by default), editing windows, privacy of presence / typing / read receipts, retention, moderation, abuse limits; regulated context controls.

messaging.common.v1.Error.description: Error envelope. Messages never contain key material, ciphertext, content, a credential or database text.

messaging.common.v1.Event.description: An event (a single occurrence or a recurring series) as the caller sees it.

scope.description: PERSONAL, CONVERSATION (with conversationId) or COMMUNITY (with communityId; 1.43.0: created by the community's owner and admins, seen by its ACTIVE members). ORGANIZATION is reserved: 422 CONTEXT_NOT_ALLOWED / EVENT_SCOPE_NOT_AVAILABLE.

communityId.description: 1.43.0: the community of a COMMUNITY event.

type.description: ONLINE needs meetingId or meetingUrl (a CF Meet meeting the client picked or created).

messaging.common.v1.EventCalendarFile.description: An RFC 5545 calendar as JSON (the relay carries JSON only); the client saves content as filename.

scope.description: PERSONAL, CONVERSATION (with conversationId) or COMMUNITY (with communityId; 1.43.0: created by the community's owner and admins, seen by its ACTIVE members). ORGANIZATION is reserved: 422 CONTEXT_NOT_ALLOWED / EVENT_SCOPE_NOT_AVAILABLE.

type.description: ONLINE needs meetingId or meetingUrl (a CF Meet meeting the client picked or created).

allDay.description: startsAt / endsAt are local midnights in timeZone.

messaging.common.v1.EventCreateRequest.description: A personal event (invitees: the creator's mutual contacts) or a conversation event (the creator an ACTIVE member allowed to send; co-organizers and invitees ACTIVE members).

syncRequired.description: The requested position is older than the retained event window: resynchronize messages by sequence.

messaging.common.v1.EventRecurrence.description: RRULE subset expanded server-side in the event time zone: FREQ, INTERVAL, COUNT or UNTIL (a local date, inclusive, at most 5 years after the start), BYDAY (WEEKLY only; the start must fall on one of the days).

type.description: ONLINE needs meetingId or meetingUrl (a CF Meet meeting the client picked or created).

allDay.description: startsAt / endsAt are local midnights in timeZone.

version.description: The version read; 409 VERSION_CONFLICT when stale.

messaging.common.v1.EventUpdateRequest.description: Organizers change the event; null clears an optional field; only the organizer changes coOrganizerPrincipalIds.

messaging.common.v1.HistoryTransfer.description: A device-to-device history transfer. Messaging relays an opaque sealed history between two ACTIVE devices of one principal; it holds no key that opens it (no recovery key, no escrow) and deletes the sealed bytes on completion, cancellation, revocation or expiry.

transferPublicKey.description: base64url X25519 HPKE public key (32 bytes) generated by the TARGET device for this transfer only.

expiresAt.description: At most one hour from now (whole seconds are signed).

requestSignature.description: Ed25519 signature by the TARGET device key over packages/messaging-crypto history_transfer::request_signing_input.

messaging.common.v1.HistoryTransferReque.description: A new device's request for the history its existing device holds (ADR 0052 AD-07).

messaging.common.v1.InvitationList.description: The acting principal's open (unexpired) invitations to ACTIVE conversations, newest first.

messaging.common.v1.InviteLink.description: S12: a group join link (never its token).

messaging.common.v1.InviteLinkCreated.description: S12: a new join link with its token, returned only here (stored as SHA-256).

deviceIds.description: Only these devices of the listed principals: a member adding a principal's NEW device leaves the KeyPackages of the devices already in the tree untouched.

messaging.common.v1.LegalHold.description: A legal / compliance hold: held items are never purged or deleted. For PRIVATE_E2EE it preserves ciphertext and metadata only; it never creates a decryption capability.

durationMs.description: Measured from the bytes (null: the container records none).

durationMatchesDeclared.description: Declared vs measured within max(1 s, 5 %); null when either is absent.

messaging.common.v1.MediaInspection.description: What the server measured in a READY MANAGED attachment's bytes (never inferred for PRIVATE_E2EE ciphertext).

authoritySource.description: How the membership came to be: an administrator or the application backend (API), an accepted invitation, the meeting integration, an invite link (INVITE_LINK) or an organization team snapshot (ORGANIZATION_TEAM, G7).

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

cryptographicRemoval.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the server-side removal is authorization only; a member's MLS commit removing the devices completes the cryptographic exclusion.

messaging.common.v1.MemberRole.description: §30: OWNER (the owner), ADMIN, MODERATOR (moderates MEMBER / READ_ONLY / BOT_SERVICE members: remove, ban, unban; no role or ownership administration), MEMBER, READ_ONLY (reads its history window, sends no messages: READ_ONLY_MEMBER), BOT_SERVICE (BOT_OR_SERVICE principals only).

frankingCommitment.description: S2: the sender's franking commitment (HMAC-SHA256, see SendMessageRequest.frankingCommitment).

e2ee.description: The protected envelope (Appendix H.1): version, protocol, cipher suite and the scope the client bound into the AAD; the server stores and relays the ciphertext without reading it.

poll.description: 1.36.0: present on poll messages (presentation POLL): options, voters and close state; null when it cannot be shown.

securityProvenance.description: NATIVE: created through Messaging. LEGACY_MANAGED: imported from a legacy chat store (MANAGED only, never presented as end-to-end encrypted).

oneOf.description: LEGACY_MANAGED: the original time at the legacy source.

channel.description: IN_APP, or SMS: arrived through the SMS Bridge (MANAGED only; never end-to-end encrypted).

replyToMessageId.description: The message this one replies to (same conversation, within the sender's history window).

threadRootId.description: The root of the reply thread (the first message replied to).

forwarded.description: S11: a server-side forward (the source conversation and message are never disclosed).

forwardedFromPrincipalId.description: S11: the original sender, only when the policy shows it (messages.forwardShowsOriginalSender).

viaApplicationId.description: ADR 0064: the CF Meet App (OAuth client id = application id) whose OAuth access or bot credential sent this message; absent on every other message.

messaging.common.v1.Message.description: A message. Content (ciphertext or MANAGED text) only while ACTIVE. e2ee for PRIVATE_E2EE rows, managed for MANAGED rows; the acceptance digest binds the server sequence and id to the ciphertext (cfmeet-messaging-acceptance:v2).

messaging.common.v1.MessageLifecycle.description: ACTIVE carries content; every other state is a tombstone without content. HIDDEN_FOR_YOU: deleted on the reader's own devices only.

messaging.common.v1.MessageRevisionPage.description: The kept prior versions of a MANAGED message, oldest first (revision n = the text after n edits). Visible to members only when editing.revisionHistoryVisible; empty for a deleted message.

groupInfo.description: base64url GroupInfo of the CURRENT epoch (as its committer published it), or null when none was published for this epoch. A member's device that is not in the tree joins from it by an external commit.

groupInfoEpoch.description: The epoch of groupInfo (always mlsEpoch when present).

moderatorPrincipalId.description: G6: the organization moderator (their principal in the organization's scope) an organization moderation request was relayed for; null for an application moderator credential.

messaging.common.v1.ModerationAction.description: Append-only; audited. No action reads PRIVATE_E2EE content.

messaging.common.v1.PermalinkResolution.description: A permalink is never authority: resolution checks current membership; a non-member and an unknown id are the same NOT_FOUND.

expiresAt.description: §49: optional pin expiry (in the future). An expired pin is no longer listed nor counted toward the limit; pinning again renews it.

messaging.common.v1.PinRequest.description: Optional body of PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/pins/{messageId}; an empty body pins without expiry.

deployment.description: What THIS deployment can run (1.23.0): PRIVATE_E2EE needs E2EE devices, MANAGED the managed key ring. usableProfiles lists, per enabled context, the allowed profiles that are actually available; contextsWithoutUsableProfile names enabled contexts in which no conversation can currently be created. A policy update that would leave a context it configures without a usable profile is refused (VALIDATION_ERROR). 1.24.0: e2eeProductionRelease is the owner's production release decision for personal E2EE (decision id, date, the ACTUAL independent-assessment status and the accepted residual risks); null outside production or while E2EE devices are disabled. It is never a certification claim.

applicationBaseline.description: 1.26.0 (CF Meet chat M1): the named, code-defined baseline layered between the platform defaults and this environment's application policy (effective = platform defaults <- baseline <- policy; an explicit policy setting always wins). CFMEET_FIRST_PARTY (CF Meet's own personal application environment only): attachments enabled, maxBytes 26214400, allowedKinds IMAGE / DOCUMENT / FILE / VOICE_NOTE / VIDEO. null for every other environment. `policy` stays the application's own document. 1.31.0: CFMEET_PLATFORM_PARTNER (ADR 0062) for EXTERNAL environments while MESSAGING_PARTNER_SESSION_DEVICES_ENABLED is on: every context class allows [MANAGED, PRIVATE_E2EE] with MANAGED as the default, attachments enabled; an explicit application setting still wins.

voterCount.description: Distinct members with a current vote.

messaging.common.v1.Poll.description: 1.36.0: the options and current tally of an ACTIVE MANAGED poll message (Message.managed.poll).

changed.description: false: nothing changed (the same vote again, or an already closed poll).

voterPrincipalIds.description: Who chose this option (members see voters, like WhatsApp).

options.description: 2-12 answers, distinct (case-insensitively) after trimming, 1-100 characters each.

messaging.common.v1.PollRequest.description: 1.36.0: a MANAGED poll (the message text, 1-300 characters, is its question). PRIVATE_E2EE polls are encrypted application messages (POLL_MANAGED_ONLY).

optionIndexes.description: The member's choices; they replace its previous vote. Empty retracts it. At most one unless the poll allowsMultipleAnswers.

shareReadReceipts.description: Appendix K: whether this principal's read position is shared with other members (its own sessions always follow it).

messaging.common.v1.PushConfiguration.description: 1.25.0: the push platforms THIS deployment delivers to, and the Web Push application-server (VAPID) public key a browser passes to pushManager.subscribe. Nothing secret and nothing per user; payloads are always metadata only (conversation id and sequences; never content, ciphertext, keys or sender).

applicationServerKey.description: base64url (no padding) uncompressed P-256 point (65 bytes).

webPush.description: null while Web Push is not configured.

pushDeliveryConfigured.description: false: no push adapter / credentials for this platform in this deployment; jobs end NOT_CONFIGURED (never reported delivered).

routingProtocol.description: Routing fence protocol of the Notification Service cutover (Document 4 §9) this replica implements; present only once its migration history is applied. Absent from pre-fence binaries.

sendPolicyProtocol.description: Block projection protocol, or null before its additive migration is ready.

sendPolicyGeneration.description: Rollout generation shared with synchronous block producers, or null when unprepared.

sendPolicyLocalEnabled.description: Whether direct sends use the prepared local block projection.

messaging.common.v1.RealtimeTicket.description: Single-use, seconds-long WebSocket ticket, presented as a Sec-WebSocket-Protocol entry (never in the URL).

keyPackage.description: base64url of the registration KeyPackage (RFC 9420 MLSMessage, wire format mls_key_package).

registrationBinding.description: The exact RFC 9420 application_id leaf extension the registration KeyPackage must carry.

credentialIdentity.description: The exact BasicCredential identity of every KeyPackage of the device.

messaging.common.v1.RegistrationChalleng.description: A single-use registration challenge with a server-assigned device id.

messaging.common.v1.ReportDetail.description: A report with its evidence (moderation.manage; audited as REPORT_VIEWED).

messaging.common.v1.ReportReceipt.description: What the reporter learns: that the report was received. The reported principal is never told who reported.

frankingKey.description: S2: the message's franking key the reporter's device decrypted (unpadded base64url, 32 bytes); with it the disclosure is verified against the sender's commitment.

disclosure.description: PRIVATE_E2EE only and optional: what the reporter's own device decrypted, disclosed voluntarily (sealed at rest). Unverifiable unless the message was franked and the disclosure carries its frankingKey (S2).

sealedHistory.description: base64url of the sealed history: HPKE (RFC 9180) ciphertext to the transfer key, signed by the SOURCE device (history_transfer::seal_history).

messaging.common.v1.SearchResults.description: Server search covers MANAGED conversations only; PRIVATE_E2EE conversations are searched on devices (LOCAL_SEARCH_ONLY).

messaging.common.v1.SecurityProfile.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: client-side MLS 1.0 encryption, the server holds no decryption key. MANAGED: server-processable, never presented as E2EE.

ciphertext.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the MLS PrivateMessage (MLSMessage bytes, base64url). Never plaintext.

text.description: MANAGED plain text (UTF-8, 1-16384 characters, no control characters). No markup subset is defined: the server never interprets HTML, Markdown or scripts, stores the text exactly as given and returns it as a JSON string; clients render it as text (escaping it), never as markup.

notify.description: false: no push notification jobs (mirrored / migrated writes). Default true.

managedPresentation.description: MANAGED only (refused for PRIVATE_E2EE, whose presentation travels inside the ciphertext).

mentionedPrincipalIds.description: Section 13: current ACTIVE members this message mentions (ids only; the sender is ignored; anyone else is VALIDATION_ERROR). Used only for the members' mention count and the "mentions only" notification preference. B3 (1.34.0): PRIVATE_E2EE accepts it too — only these ids reach the server, the mention text stays inside the ciphertext; not on an EDIT. A retry with the same clientMessageId must repeat the text and the attachment set (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED otherwise) and is answered before rate limits are charged.

frankingCommitment.description: S2, PRIVATE_E2EE only (optional): hex(HMAC-SHA256(frankingKey, 'cfmeet-messaging-franking:v1' || 0x00 || conversationId || clientMessageId || senderPrincipalId (16 bytes each) || plaintext UTF-8)). The client draws a fresh 32-byte frankingKey per message and carries it INSIDE the MLS plaintext; recipients check the commitment after decryption. MANAGED sends refuse it (FRANKING_E2EE_ONLY).

poll.description: 1.36.0, MANAGED only: this message is a poll (text is its question; no attachments; not an announcement). The message's managed.presentation is POLL.

messaging.common.v1.SendMessageRequest.description: Which fields apply is decided by the conversation's PERSISTED security profile: PRIVATE_E2EE needs deviceId, epoch and ciphertext and refuses text (CONTENT_REJECTED / PLAINTEXT_IN_E2EE); MANAGED needs text and refuses ciphertext.

messaging.common.v1.SessionDeviceToken.description: A realtime-only client token bound to a session device: POST /v1/realtime/tickets and the WebSocket accept it; every device-direct REST operation refuses it (CLIENT_TOKENS_NOT_ENABLED / SESSION_DEVICE_REALTIME_ONLY); the gateway refuses PRIVATE_E2EE subscriptions (E2EE_DEVICE_REQUIRED). A session device is never an end-to-end encrypted device.

deviceId.description: The session device id (never a registered MLS device).

messaging.common.v1.SessionDeviceTokenRe.description: Section 13 (ADR 0049 amendment A1). Sent only by a first-party relay acting for a VERIFIED account session; a client never supplies the binding.

accountSessionRef.description: The relay's opaque, domain-separated SHA-256 reference of the account session (Messaging matches it, never reverses it).

notAfter.description: No token outlives this instant (the account access token's own expiry).

sessionDeviceId.description: Renew a token of this ACTIVE session device of the same account session (an open connection then continues with auth.refresh).

messaging.common.v1.SmsBridgeDisclosure.description: Part V H §106: the disclosure a bridge creator must acknowledge (version-pinned).

messaging.common.v1.SmsTransport.description: Carrier state of one bridged message — separate from in-app delivery and read state (§110).

storedParts.description: Owner only: the parts the store holds (resume an upload).

fileName.description: 1.40.0: a channel document's shown file name.

messaging.common.v1.SocialMedia.description: A status / channel photo, video or voice note (bytes in protected object storage, one object per part).

sizeBytes.description: IMAGE / AUDIO at most 8 MiB, VIDEO at most 64 MiB, DOCUMENT (channels only) at most 32 MiB.

fileName.description: 1.40.0: required for DOCUMENT (its path is dropped).

messaging.common.v1.SocialMediaDownloadG.description: Short-lived signed reads of every part, minted only after the reader passed the status / channel gate.

messaging.common.v1.SocialMediaPartUploa.description: A signed single-object upload of one part (null `upload` when the part is already stored with this digest).

replyCount.description: Author only: private replies recorded for this status (an upper bound until the replies are listed).

messaging.common.v1.Status.description: A status as the caller sees it. viewCount, shareCount, mentions and audience are present for the author only.

messaging.common.v1.StatusReplyEntry.description: One private reply to the caller's status: the MANAGED direct message it is, read through the author's own membership.

text.description: What the replier wrote (null when the server cannot read it).

mentionedMe.description: A visible live status of this person mentions the caller (never true for the caller's own ring).

mentionedMeUnseen.description: One of those mentioning statuses is not seen yet by the caller.

messaging.common.v1.StatusUpdateRequest.description: 1.38.0: the author changes Allow sharing of one live status (forwards and reshares check it when they happen).

reactedAt.description: When the viewer set their current reaction (null without one).

unreadReplyCount.description: Replies from others after the caller's read cursor.

messaging.common.v1.ThreadSummary.description: §47: a thread's reply count, last reply and the caller's unread replies, counted only inside the caller's history window (active, not hidden).

messaging.common.v1.ThumbnailGrant.description: A short-lived read of a MANAGED image's thumbnail, authorized exactly like a download grant of the original.

leafData.description: base64url of the exact leaf bytes the log hashed (canonical JSON).

logId.description: The deployment's key-transparency log (stable across key rotation); signed.

timestamp.description: When this head was produced (RFC 3339, microseconds).

timestampMicros.description: The same instant in Unix microseconds: exactly what the signature covers.

keyId.description: First 8 bytes (hex) of SHA-256 of the log's Ed25519 public key, which clients pin out of band.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over the length-prefixed encoding of label 'cfmeet-messaging-kt-tree-head:v1', logId, treeSize (u64 BE), rootHash and timestampMicros (i64 BE) — packages/messaging-crypto transparency::tree_head_signing_input / verify_tree_head_signature (Part V G.5).

witnessStatus.description: WITNESSED only when at least witnessQuorum distinct configured witnesses cosigned exactly this head (verify with packages/messaging-crypto transparency::verify_witnessed_tree_head against witness keys you pin). UNWITNESSED: verifiable but not, by itself, anti-equivocation.

witnessQuorum.description: Distinct witness cosignatures this deployment requires for WITNESSED (0: no witnesses configured).

cosignatures.description: Witness cosignatures of exactly this head (logId, treeSize, rootHash, timestampMicros), each already verified by Messaging under the witness's pinned key; clients verify them again.

messaging.common.v1.TreeHead.description: A SIGNED tree head (Part V G.5) with the cosignatures of independent key-transparency witnesses (AD-05). The log signing key is a server secret distinct from the service-authentication key. A witness cosigns a head only after verifying the log signature and a consistency proof from the last head it cosigned, so a quorum of witnesses prevents the log from showing different views.

position.description: Move the list to this place (beyond the end: last); the other lists keep their relative order.

retentionSeconds.description: §90 / disappearing messages: a conversation-specific retention, never looser than the context's (or environment's) retention policy (RETENTION_LOOSER_THAN_POLICY). The retention worker expires older messages (tombstone, then purge unless a legal hold protects them); clients delete locally on the same timer. Audited. B4 (1.34.0): it can be shortened, lengthened or turned off (null) within that limit — by the owner, a group's ADMIN or either member of a DIRECT conversation (another member: 403 PRINCIPAL_NOT_AUTHORIZED / NOT_ADMIN); each message keeps the retention in force when it was sent, so a change applies to messages sent after it.

title.description: Section 13: a new display title; null clears it (MANAGED only, owner).

avatarRef.description: Section 13: a new avatar reference; null clears it (MANAGED only). 1.36.0: attachment:<attachmentId> names a READY image attachment uploaded to this conversation (the group photo; members read it through the attachment download / thumbnail grants, and it is not removed as an abandoned upload while it is the avatar). Title, avatarRef and description alone may be changed by the owner or a group admin.

announcementOnly.description: S13 (owner): announcement-only on / off; GROUP and CHANNEL only.

description.description: 1.36.0: a new group description; null clears it (MANAGED, non-DIRECT; the owner or a group admin).

messaging.common.v1.UpdateConversationRe.description: Optimistic concurrency on the aggregate version. EXPIRED is set by the server only. A security profile can never be changed (SECURITY_PROFILE_IMMUTABLE).

pricing.description: Messaging records usage facts only; it never prices or bills.

messaging.common.v1.UsageSummary.description: Usage facts of the caller's application environment (Part V I §129): quantities only, no price, rate or cost.

messaging.common.v1.UserPushRegistration.description: ADR 0063: a partner push registration as the Notification Service accepted it (never the handle).

installationId.description: Stable per app installation, generated by the SDK.

messaging.common.v1.UserPushRegistration.description: ADR 0063: a partner device's push handle (an APNs / APNs VoIP device token or an FCM registration token). Synchronised to the Notification Service; Messaging never stores, echoes or logs it.

messaging.common.v1.UserSession.description: ADR 0062: a MANAGED-only partner session device and a short-lived client token bound to it (scopes: the user token's effective msg grants; read -> messages.read / attachments.read, send -> messages.send / attachments.write). Present it as `Authorization: CF-Client-Token <clientToken>` to POST /v1/realtime/tickets and to the partner REST allowlist; renew through this exchange.

messaging.common.v1.UserSessionRequest.description: ADR 0062: the body of POST /v1/messaging/user-sessions (Authorization: Bearer cfut_...).

installationId.description: Stable per app installation, generated by the SDK.

sessionDeviceId.description: Renew this ACTIVE partner session device of the same principal and installation (NOT_FOUND otherwise).

cosignedAtMicros.description: When the witness cosigned (Unix microseconds); signed.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the length-prefixed encoding of label 'cfmeet-messaging-kt-witness-cosignature:v1', witnessId, logId, treeSize (u64 BE), rootHash, timestampMicros (i64 BE) and cosignedAtMicros (i64 BE) — packages/messaging-crypto transparency::witness_cosignature_input.

messaging.common.v1.WitnessCosignature.description: One witness's cosignature of a tree head.

platform.common.v1.RequestId.description: Server-generated identifier of one request / one service hop.
